content.stem: 以下哪些是证券行业可能存在的洗钱迹象？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将经纪账户当作存款账户来使用。
options.B: 配偶去世后将证券接收至现有经纪账户。
options.C: 允许固定收益证券到期。
options.D: 与代名人或第三方进行交易。

content.stem_en: Which of the following are common indicators of possible money laundering within the securities industry? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Using brokerage accounts like deposit accounts.
options_en.B: Receiving securities into an existing brokerage account following the death of a spouse.
options_en.C: Allowing fixed income securities to mature.
options_en.D: Engaging in transactions involving nominees or third parties.
